name: cholesky_inverse
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::cholesky_inverse(Tensor self, bool upper=False) -> Tensor. Computes the inverse from lower- or upper-triangular Cholesky factors without mutating self. The FlagGems empty-input fast path returns self with Python and storage identity, while nonempty paths materialize independent output and explicitly do not support autograd. Tests cover unbatched and batched positive-definite systems, both upper modes, float32 and supported float64, empty alias/gradient semantics, and the documented Kunlunxin float64 limitation.
